fireSprite.01a.note: Flame face with hollow eyes, a gasp and a curl of smoke; the dark ground, warm light and oil hand of the leaders; reads at 48 px.

fireSprite.01b.note: A smooth, smiling yellow mask like a cartoon sun; re-rolled.

fireSprite.01b.r2.note: Now formed of smoky flame, but still a grinning, cartoon-like face; the horn points are only flame tips. Second attempt: reported. Superseded by the no-grin wording (fix2 r3).

hornetSwarm.01a.note: Good painting, but furry like a bumblebee; re-rolled. It passes every gate and is the fallback.

hornetSwarm.01a.r2.note: A hard-shelled hornet, the most convincing insect of the four. fix2 (critique-resume fix 7): its ochre face plate was graded instead of re-rolled (saturation x0.65 for hues 30-70 degrees): muted 0.038 -> 0.002, read48 22.9; the plate now reads dull ochre, not yellow.

hornetSwarm.01b.note: Lean dark hornet with narrow ochre bands, open jagged mandibles and a torn wing; reads as a hornet at 48 px.

wolf.01a.note: Lean grey timber wolf with amber eyes, in the leaders' hand; the notched ear did not come out.

wolf.01b.note: Old wolf with the scar across the near eye and one fang showing; the more characterful of the pair.

giant.01a.note: Old bald giant, coarse heavy features, stones and beads in the beard, the tooth necklace and hide cloak; reads as a giant, not a man.

giant.01b.note: A near copy of 01a (same text); re-rolled as a real alternative.

giant.01b.r2.note: The same giant with a closed, sullen scowl and the hide pulled high on the neck; now a real alternative to 01a.

giant.02a.note: A rugged, handsome man rather than a giant; re-rolled.

giant.02a.r2.note: Brutish profile with a heavy jaw and brow, the clouded scarred eye, chain and slate guard; reads as a giant. It came out a near copy of 02b r2 (same text and note), so face 02 offers one look, not two.

giant.02b.note: A rugged, handsome man rather than a giant; re-rolled.

giant.02b.r2.note: Brutish, heavy face, the clouded eye with its scar, the chain, slate guard and fleece; reads as a giant. Near copy of 02a r2.

oakheart.01a.note: A carved man's face with eyes, lids, a nose and a beard; re-rolled.

oakheart.01a.r2.note: Closer: a wooden mask with dark knothole eyes under the thorned bark helm, oak leaves, bottle-green mantle and acorns; but the grain still forms a nose and a beard. Second attempt: reported. Superseded by the no-nose wording (fix2 r3).

oakheart.01b.note: Grey furrowed oak with moss, a crown of curved thorns, an oak-leaf fringe and hollow knothole eyes; the face reads a little skull-like.

ashHorse.01a.note: Dark dappled warhorse, riveted iron chanfron with rusted edges, soot-black mane, the ember caparison edge at the withers; fully in the leaders' hand.

ashHorse.01b.note: Older horse, head lowered, greyer muzzle, the same tack; the caparison shows a little more.

warWolf.01a.note: Grey-brown timber wolf in a bark-plate harness with the bottle-green blanket and bone cord; its coat matches the grey Wolf Rider test figure (the figure's green chest cloth becomes bark plates in stage C).

warWolf.01b.note: The darker coat of review change 11, bared teeth, the same tack; the darker coat helps the stage C value margin on swamp ground.

oracle-cinderHorde.01a.note: Hooded seer in the robe with its glyph band, the ragged hem drifting above the ground and the gold-caged orb staff; the face shows more than the cowl's shadow allows.

oracle-thornwood.01a.note: Same body as the Cinder candidate; the tint zone repainted bottle green.

oracle-cinderHorde.01b.note: Deeper candle shadow, the hem floating above its own shadow; read48 overridden (the card crop reads).

oracle-thornwood.01b.note: Same body as the Cinder candidate; the tint zone repainted bottle green.

titan-cinderHorde.01a.note: Followed its maquette's bulk: squat, short-legged, dwarf-like; re-rolled.

titan-thornwood.01a.note: Edit of the squat first body; made again from the re-rolled body.

titan-cinderHorde.01a.r2.note: Tall great-helmed knight in worn gold plate and the tabard, sword point-down: heroic proportions now; close to 01b.

titan-thornwood.01a.r2.note: Re-edited from the re-rolled body; tabard bottle green.

titan-cinderHorde.01b.note: Taller and more weathered, torn tabard hem; the gold reads brighter than the leaders' dull metals.

titan-thornwood.01b.note: Same body as the Cinder candidate; the tint zone repainted bottle green.

greatWyrm-cinderHorde.01a.note: Bronze banded dragon with swept horns, wings in the side's colour and the spade tail, standing on a faint floor; the membranes' trailing edges are a little ragged for variant 0's smooth wings.

greatWyrm-thornwood.01a.note: Same body as the Cinder candidate; the tint zone repainted bottle green.

greatWyrm-cinderHorde.01b.note: S-curved neck, tail curled forward round the feet; the same slight raggedness on the membranes.

greatWyrm-thornwood.01b.note: Same body as the Cinder candidate; the tint zone repainted bottle green.

livingMonolith-cinderHorde.01a.note: Roots and mound ran out of the bottom edge; re-rolled.

livingMonolith-cinderHorde.01a.r2.note: Pale slab with rows of glyphs in ember pigment, the root-gripped mound inside the frame; the glyphs look like a real historical alphabet rather than invented ones.

livingMonolith-thornwood.01a.r2.note: Same body; the glyph green still comes out olive grey-green, not bottle green (window 0.007 < 0.01). Second attempt: reported. The 01b Thornwood monolith passes. Superseded by the every-glyph-filled edit (fix2 r3).

livingMonolith-cinderHorde.01b.note: Weathered slab, ember glyphs, roots and stones at the base.

livingMonolith-thornwood.01b.note: Same body; green glyphs, just over the gate (window 0.011).

ascendedHero-cinderHorde.01a.note: Circlet, long cape, plain breastplate, sword upright before the chest; reads as a noble mortal knight rather than a god.

ascendedHero-thornwood.01a.note: Same body as the Cinder candidate; the tint zone repainted bottle green.

ascendedHero-cinderHorde.01b.note: Boots cut by the bottom edge, sword held low; re-rolled.

ascendedHero-cinderHorde.01b.r2.note: Inside the frame now, but the sword is held out at an angle instead of upright before the chest, and the figure is plain.

ascendedHero-thornwood.01b.note: Edit of the re-rolled body; cape bottle green; same pose issue.

primordial-cinderHorde.01a.note: The moss came out green with orange flecks (side window 0.015); re-rolled.

primordial-cinderHorde.01a.r2.note: Massive humped beast with the ember lichen back, mottled hide and club tail; but the head reads as a gentle ram, not a primeval bull-sloth. Superseded by the corrected bull-head design (fix2 r3).

primordial-thornwood.01a.note: Edit of the re-rolled body; moss bottle green (window 0.053). Same ram head. Superseded: edit of the corrected r3 body (fix2).

primordial-cinderHorde.01b.note: Heavier bull-ram body, ember moss; the same ram head. An extra attempt at a bull's head (r2) came out thinner and goat-like and was rejected. Superseded by the corrected bull-head design (fix2 r3).

primordial-thornwood.01b.note: Same body; moss leaf-green rather than bottle green (window 0.012, at the gate). Superseded: edit of the corrected r3 body (fix2).

primordial-cinderHorde.01b.r2.note: Art director re-roll for the head: still a ram's head, and the body came out thin and goat-like; worse than the first. The first version stays; its Thornwood edit stands.

ashColossus-cinderHorde.01a.note: Charred ember giant, brazier head with coals and eye-holes, faint cracks, ember kilt on a gold chain, bare fists; the bowl head reads a little comic.

ashColossus-cinderHorde.01b.note: More massive, ash crust on the shoulders, ember cracks and drifting specks; read48 overridden (the card crop reads).

ashPhoenix-cinderHorde.01a.note: Coal-dark barred eagle with a plume crest, fan wings in ember, gold beak, trailing tail and ember specks; reads at 48 px.

ashPhoenix-cinderHorde.01b.note: Wings raised higher, rim light along the feathers; the strongest god silhouette.

pyreLord-cinderHorde.01a.note: Flame crown, ember mantle, scale armour, the glaive with its gold collar and the open palm; the ash stripes did not come out.

pyreLord-cinderHorde.01b.note: Same kit, legs sinking into the candle shadow; framing gate overridden (feet at 0.95).

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01a.note: Smoke ran off the top edge, glyph colour too small; re-rolled.

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01b.note: Smoke ran off the top edge, glyph colour too small; re-rolled.

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01a.r2.note: Squat brazier-faced idol on its stepped plinth, broad ember glyphs, a short wisp of smoke; it has stub arms where the design has none. Superseded by the slab design that fits its rig (fix2 r3).

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01b.r2.note: Same idol, the glyph colour still small (side window 0.023 < 0.03). Second attempt: reported. Superseded by the slab design that fits its rig (fix2 r3).

emberHierophant-cinderHorde.01a.note: Gold mask under the charcoal hood, ember mantle, glyph stole, orb staff in a gold claw, raised palm; the leaders' light.

emberHierophant-cinderHorde.01b.note: The same priest more frontal; mask and staff read at 48 px.

wildSpirit-thornwood.01a.note: Lean striped stag-spirit with the green leaf ruff, half-misty outline and trailing wisps; card crop set by hand on the head.

wildSpirit-thornwood.01b.note: Faced the left side of the image; re-rolled.

wildSpirit-thornwood.01b.r2.note: Faces right, forefoot lifted, mist at the legs; card crop set by hand on the head.

worldTree-thornwood.01a.note: Correct and clear, but a plain round oak, a little clean-digital; the card shows the whole tree.

worldTree-thornwood.01b.note: A near copy of 01a with almost no rim light; re-rolled.

worldTree-thornwood.01b.r2.note: Gnarled, twisting trunk with buttress roots under the round canopy; a real alternative; the card shows the whole tree.

hornedHunter-thornwood.01a.note: Antlered, bearded hunter-god with warpaint, the green leaf mantle and the gold leaf-bladed spear.

hornedHunter-thornwood.01b.note: The same god, a little stiffer; reads at 48 px.

elderWyrm-thornwood.01a.note: Wingless bronze dragon with the crown of spines, green moss back and club tail; compact rather than long and low. Superseded: it sat up on its haunches, against its low serpent rig (fix2 r3).

elderWyrm-thornwood.01b.note: Longer body and tail; the moss is leaf-green, near the gate's edge (window 0.035). Superseded: upright chest and raised head, against its low serpent rig (fix2 r3).

motherOfBeasts-thornwood.01a.note: Antler crown, bear pelt with the bear's head on her shoulder, green dress, gold-banded maul head-down; reads human-sized rather than towering.

motherOfBeasts-thornwood.01b.note: Too dark (read48 9.2); re-rolled for the light.

motherOfBeasts-thornwood.01b.r2.note: Face, crown and bear's head now catch the candle; read48 11.5 overridden (whole-body median; the card crop reads).

primordial-cinderHorde.01a.r3.note: A heavy bull-bison face with a deep brow, furious small eyes, broad muzzle and shaggy beard, framed by the ridged ram's horns; the head is carried forward at chest height, well below the mossy hump; the studded club tail is raised and reads. The face is turned almost straight at us.

primordial-cinderHorde.01b.r3.note: The head hangs low and forward below the shoulder line like a bison's, bearded, ram's horns curling round the skull; massive body, ember lichen hump, studded club tail clear behind the haunches. Matches the quadruped maquette's low head.

primordial-thornwood.01a.r3.note: Edit of the r3 body; the moss repainted bottle green (window 0.085, lock 0.22).

primordial-thornwood.01b.r3.note: Edit of the r3 body; moss bottle green (window 0.055); read48 11.9 overridden (the same body read 12.3 in its Cinder palette).

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01a.r3.note: Now a standing slab like its maquette: no arms, no legs; a stern carved face in the upper front with coals glowing in the eyes and mouth, a gold-rimmed brazier of coals on top, two rows of ember glyphs and a glyph band on the stepped plinth. The slab is a little rounded and the face more naturalistic than flat. Side window 0.0299 overridden (the glyphs read ember at 64 px).

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01b.r3.note: A slab with a face as designed, but its smoke ran off the top edge (framing: top 0.0); re-rolled once (r4).

cinderIdol-cinderHorde.01b.r4.note: A squared granite slab broken at its top corner, a deeper-cut stern face, four rows of ember glyphs and a band on the plinth, a short wisp of smoke inside the frame; a real alternative to A, not a copy.

elderWyrm-thornwood.01a.r3.note: Crawls low like the serpent rig: splayed legs, belly near the ground, head level and low, the long tail arching back to the upper right; crown of spines, green moss back, club tail. Its claws stand at about 0.90 (lowest-row override: the floor shadow reaches the edge) and read48 11.6 is overridden (reads on the 48 px board).

elderWyrm-thornwood.01b.r3.note: The truest to the rig (a long, flat salamander body) but small in the square (top 0.15, lowest 0.77, fill 0.63); re-rolled once for the framing (r4).

elderWyrm-thornwood.01b.r4.note: Fills the square now, the tail club curling up near the top; long and low-slung, its height well under half its length, but it walks on straighter legs than the rig's splayed crawl, so the belly is clear of the ground. Body-fill 0.705 against 0.72 overridden.

fireSprite.01b.r3.note: No grin now: a wild flame face roaring with a ragged open mouth, swept-back flame hair and smoke; the ragged edge of the mouth reads a little like fangs and the face a little skull-like.

oakheart.01a.r3.note: Better: no beard or moustache now, a heavy split block of bark under the thorned helm; but the grain still carves a straight nose and lidded eyes, so it still reads as a man in a wooden mask. The corrected design's one roll: reported, not rolled again. B remains the stronger Oakheart.

livingMonolith-thornwood.01a.r3.note: Same slab as the Cinder 01a r2; every glyph now filled bottle green (window 0.011, lock 0.11).

ascendedHero-cinderHorde.01b.r3.note: Same failure as r2: the sword is held low at the side on a diagonal, not upright before the chest, and the figure is a near copy of r2. The corrected design's one roll: reported, not rolled again; r2 stays as candidate B, and its Thornwood edit (P13) was not made from a failing body.
